snippet.title: [New Trailer] Reggie & his Cousin: Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://t.co/gcmyG3NjWj

The fate of the Universe is in Reggie's hands. Unfortunately, Reggie is just a regular guy from the 16,000th century who has no idea what he's doing.

Something unknown is altering the past with catastrophic consequences! Accidentally dragged into this wild time-travel quest alongside two eccentric (and annoying) scientists, Reggie must stop a disaster of colossal dimensions. Explore a story filled with absurd characters and chaotic sci-fi humor where the most unlikely hero must somehow save existence.

Master the flow and defy the laws of physics in a high-precision Gravity-Parkour platformer. Built for both solo play and local co-op, every level offers unique mechanics and challenges that drive a narrative told through over an hour of hand-animated cutscenes.

Massive 20-80 Hour Adventure: A content-rich journey packed with intimidating bosses, tricky combos, and time trials.

High-Precision Gravity-Parkour: Tight, responsive controls designed to master movement and physics in every era.

Hand-Animated Cinematics: Experience the story through high-quality animation that brings the chaotic world of Reggie to life.

Deep Progression: Discover hidden collectibles, unlockable skins, and secret challenges that test your skills to the limit.

.... the future is broken. Do you dare to you fix it?

Coming 2026!

#videogames #reggiegame #indiegame #indiegames
